segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ שְׁתֵּי מְנָחוֹת שֶׁלֹּא נִקְמְצוּ וְנִתְעָרְבוּ זוֹ בָּזוֹ, אִם יָכוֹל לִקְמוֹץ מִזּוֹ בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ וּמִזּוֹ בִּפְנֵי עַצְמָהּ – כְּשֵׁירוֹת, וְאִם לָאו – פְּסוּלוֹת.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» In the case of «two meal offerings from which a handful was not removed and» that «were intermingled with each other, if» the priest «can remove a handful from this» meal offering «by itself and from that» meal offering «by itself, they are fit» meal offerings, «but if not, they are unfit,» as the handful of each meal offering must be taken from its original source.

segments.he: קוֹמֶץ שֶׁנִּתְעָרֵב בְּמִנְחָה שֶׁלֹּא נִקְמְצָה – לֹא יַקְטִיר, וְאִם הִקְטִיר – זוֹ שֶׁנִּקְמְצָה עָלַת לַבְּעָלִים, וְזוֹ שֶׁלֹּא נִקְמְצָה לֹא עָלַת לַבְּעָלִים.
segments.en: In the case of «a handful that was intermingled with a meal offering from which a handful was not removed,» the priest «should not burn» the mixture on the altar. «And if he burned» it, «this» meal offering «from which the handful was taken satisfies the obligation of the owner and that» meal offering «from which the handful was not taken does not satisfy the obligation of the owner.»

segments.he: נִתְעָרֵב קוּמְצָהּ בִּשְׁיָרֶיהָ, אוֹ בִּשְׁיָרֶיהָ שֶׁל חֲבֶירְתָּהּ – לֹא יַקְטִיר, וְאִם הִקְטִיר – עָלַת לַבְּעָלִים.
segments.en: If, after it was removed, «its handful was intermingled with its remainder or with the remainder of another» meal offering, the priest «should not burn» the mixture on the altar, «but if he burned» it, «it satisfies the obligation of the owner.»

moves.summary: Two mixed meal offerings: fit if each can be handfulled separately

positions.claim: two unhandfulled meal offerings mixed are fit only if a handful can be taken from each separately
a handful mixed with an unhandfulled offering is not burned; if burned, only the handfulled one counts
a handful mixed with remainders is not burned; if burned, it counts for the owner
